secretsTab.intro: Secrets an org holds by name. Paste the reference into any connection field and the value is resolved when the connection is used — it is never stored beside it.
secretsTab.providerBuiltIn: Values are encrypted under this deployment's master key and held in the control plane.
secretsTab.providerCentral: This deployment reads its secrets from {{provider}}, which owns creating and deleting them. Add a secret there and reference it by name here.
secretsTab.nameHelp: Letters, digits and underscores. This is what you reference.
secretsTab.descriptionPlaceholder: Push access to the model repository
secretsTab.valueHelp: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again — a lost value is replaced, not recovered.
secretsTab.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Anything still referencing it will fail when it is next used.
secretsTab.serviceIntro: Which service resolves ${secret:NAME} for this deployment. Every backend this build supports is listed; one whose client library is not installed cannot be selected until it is installed.
